AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: LipiRx manages prescription scanning, medical entity parsing, generic substitute search, patient safety auditing, and AgentOps telemetry traces. Operational Patterns: - Use 'getPrescriptionHistory' to view scanned prescriptions and medicine summaries. - Use 'parseMedicalEntities' to extract structured medicine names, dosages, forms, and schedules from raw medical text. - Use 'searchGenericSubstitutes' to find generic active ingredients and Bangladeshi brand substitutes for prescribed medicines. - Use 'auditPatientSafety' to evaluate dosage safety, flag ambiguous items, and check contraindications. - Use 'getAgentExecutionTraces' to inspect AgentOps execution logs and supervisor turn records.
